issues.where: crops S, V and W, bottom of frame 2 (image-05), nearest foreground, mostly the lower right
issues.what: the near granulation breaks down into smeared, streaky shapes that look like brush strokes and are stretched diagonally; cell edges dissolve and the surface reads as a warped AI texture, not as structure
issues.fix: regenerate or upscale the near foreground with crisp cell boundaries and no directional smearing, and keep cell shapes consistent with the middle ground

issues.where: whole photosphere, both frames (crops D, E, P, Q, T, U)
issues.what: the granules have glossy specular highlights, like wet liquid gold or hammered metal, so the surface reads as plastic or chrome and not as glowing plasma; the light seems to come from outside instead of the surface glowing on its own
issues.fix: remove the specular reflections and the shading by an outside light; make the granules evenly emissive, with bright centres and dark, narrow intergranular lanes

issues.where: crops S to W, bottom strip of frame 1
issues.what: the foreground is soft and slightly blurry next to the sharper middle ground, with mushy highlights and a muddy brown between the cells
issues.fix: sharpen the foreground detail or apply depth of field on purpose and evenly; avoid a texture that only looks low resolution

issues.where: sky just above the limb, left and right (crops I, N, Q, R)
issues.what: a dark, smoky band lies between the limb glow and the starfield and reads as a cut-out halo or a hazy layer edge, as if the sun were pasted over the sky plate
issues.fix: blend the limb glow smoothly into the sky, with no dark ring in between

issues.where: loop arcade, crops H and C in image-06
issues.what: the loop filaments look like sparks or steel wool and end in scattered bright specks, with a few dangling strands that hang straight down, so they look like particle sparks and not plasma
issues.fix: make the loops continuous, smooth flux tubes, with fewer scattered spark particles

issues.where: limb spicule fringe, crops N and I
issues.what: the spicules along the limb look like hair, all one length, with a slightly repeated, comb-like pattern
issues.fix: vary the length, density and brightness of the spicules along the limb

issues.what: cell size and shape repeat evenly across the middle band, with little large-scale variation, so the surface reads as a tiled pattern
issues.fix: add variation at large scale (mesogranular brightness changes, plage near the spot)

issues.where: far photosphere just below the limb (image-10.png crops A, F, G, I; image-11.png crops N, O, P, Q)
issues.what: horizontal and vertical mirror seams create symmetrical kaleidoscope reflections across the distant granulation right behind the sunspot
issues.fix: replace mirrored UV tiling near the horizon with continuous 3D procedural granulation or non-mirrored spherical projection

issues.where: right-side Milky Way sky (image-14.png crop I; image-15.png crops M, R)
issues.what: a ruler-straight vertical tile seam cuts top-to-bottom through the nebula with an abrupt drop in brightness and dust color
issues.fix: project a seamless equirectangular starfield skybox or blend and feather the background sky boundary seamlessly

issues.where: upper sky around the coronal arch and Milky Way dust (image-10.png crops B, C, H; image-11.png crops K, L)
issues.what: a jagged, posterized black moat outlines the outer edge of the warm glow patch before transitioning to the surrounding starfield
issues.fix: composite the coronal glow and nebula layers additively in linear 16/32-bit float with a smooth, unthresholded falloff

issues.where: white coronal streamers around the limb (image-14.png crops B, C, D, E, G; image-15.png crops K, L; image-16.png crops U, V)
issues.what: dozens of dark gray circular and polygonal blotches pepper the bright coronal rays like negative matte or star-removal holes
issues.fix: render the coronal streamers on a clean volumetric/additive pass without dark dust-spot or star-subtraction artifacts

issues.where: near foreground solar surface along the bottom (image-12.png crops S, T, U, V, W; image-10.png crops D, E)
issues.what: foreground granules are heavily blurred and radially stretched toward the bottom corners, failing to hold up at native crop size
issues.fix: disable shallow depth-of-field blur and maintain crisp, undistorted high-frequency granulation into the near foreground

issues.where: mid-ground photosphere granulation (image-10.png crops D, E, F, G; image-11.png crops N, O, P, Q)
issues.what: granules look like glossy embossed metallic or plastic pillows with hard pinpoint specular glints inside dark intergranular lanes
issues.fix: remove specular/glossy reflection lobes and shade the photosphere purely as self-luminous plasma with realistic temperature emission

issues.where: chromosphere above the bright left coronal-loop footpoint (image-10.png crops A, F; image-11.png crop O)
issues.what: an artificial ruler-straight horizontal bright streak cuts across the vertical plasma spicules and loop base
issues.fix: remove the horizontal anamorphic flare line and use natural isotropic bloom around bright footpoints

issues.where: left-side starfield (image-10.png crop I; image-11.png crop J)
issues.what: stars near the left frame edge are smeared into elongated coma blobs and doubled smudges
issues.fix: render background stars as crisp, radially symmetric point spread functions without edge coma distortion

issues.where: solar globe limb curve (image-14.png crops B, C, F, G; image-15.png crops K, L)
issues.what: a sharp bright hairline rim with a thin dark gap traces the geometric sphere edge beneath the chromospheric spicules
issues.fix: feather the photosphere limb into the chromosphere optically so spicules integrate without a hard doubled disc edge

issues.where: crops U and V, lower limb and corona
issues.what: Long, nearly parallel strands have the same soft blur and taper, making the corona look like a radial-blur layer.
issues.fix: Break up the strands with finer, locally curved filaments and vary their length, spacing, and falloff around the limb.

issues.where: crops A and F, active regions on the disk
issues.what: Several active regions share the same tight rosette shape: a dark pinched center ringed by evenly curled bright filaments.
issues.fix: Vary the shape and scale of the active regions, and interrupt the radial curls with asymmetric filament bundles and irregular spot clusters.

issues.where: crops K and L, upper limb
issues.what: The thin, almost uniformly bright yellow rim reads as a traced outline against the softer corona.
issues.fix: Vary the rim's brightness and width locally, and feather it into the finer emission just above the disk.
